lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to chisel out two new stone tablets, and Moses carries them up Mount Sinai early in the morning.
The LORD descends in a cloud and proclaims His name, saying He is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, and forgiving.
Moses bows down and worships, then asks the Lord to go with them and take them as His inheritance.
The LORD promises to drive out the Amorites and other peoples, and tells Israel to make treaties with them and keep their altars.

wrong_details.wrong: make treaties with them and keep their altars
wrong_details.true: not to make a treaty with them, and to tear down their altars

lines.text: Moses spends seven days and seven nights with the LORD, then comes down with a radiant face and puts a veil over it.
